北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京扬沙，风力 4 级，体感 9℃。请防沙保暖，多喝水。
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing: sand, strong winds, feels 9℃. Protect yourself, stay warm, hydrate.

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪晴空万里，体感 15℃。享受美好春光吧！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is sunny and feels 15℃. Enjoy the beautiful spring day!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海晴好，体感 14℃ 左右。微风正好，出门踏青去。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is sunny and feels 14℃. A gentle breeze, perfect for an outing!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天暖和，体感 24℃。注意防晒，保持心情愉快。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy and warm, feels 24℃. Stay happy and protect from sun.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阳光正好，体感 20℃。湿度高，出行记得带伞哦。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and feels 20℃. High humidity, remember to bring an umbrella.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州晴朗舒适，体感 16℃。风和日丽，适合户外活动。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is sunny and pleasant, feels 16℃. Great for outdoor activities.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴好，体感 16℃。微风舒适，享受这好天气吧。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is sunny, feels 16℃. A light breeze, enjoy the nice weather.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都晴朗舒适，体感 17℃。风力微弱，适宜外出。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is sunny and pleasant, feels 17℃. Gentle breeze, good for going out.
成都.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉晴朗，体感 15℃。湿度较高，注意防潮哦。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is sunny, feels 15℃. High humidity, please mind the moisture.
武汉.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗，体感 15℃。湿度仅 5%，请多补水润肤哦！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny, feels 15℃. Humidity is 5%, please hydrate and moisturize!
西安.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆晴朗温暖，体感 21℃。心情也会放晴哦！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is sunny and warm, feels 21℃. Your mood will also clear up!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨阴天微凉，体感 1℃。记得添衣保暖，别着凉。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is cloudy and chilly, feels 1℃. Remember to dress warm and avoid catching cold.

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳多云微凉，体感 3℃，风力 3 级。注意防风保暖。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy and cool, feels 3℃. Moderate wind, keep warm.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴朗舒适，体感 18℃。湿度低，记得多喝水。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny and pleasant, feels 18℃. Low humidity, remember to drink more water.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门晴朗，体感 13℃，湿度 72%。户外活动注意防潮。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is sunny, feels 13℃. High humidity, mind the moisture outdoors.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云微凉，体感 6℃，风力 3 级。记得加件外套。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy and cool, feels 6℃. Moderate wind, remember to wear a jacket.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云寒冷，体感 2℃，风力 3 级。注意防寒保暖。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy and cold, feels 2℃. Moderate wind, stay warm and bundled up.
